rules.statement: The Sinhala word 'bharakaraya' in the context of a deed of gift does not create a fideicommissum, as it is equivalent to 'assigns'.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore, we the said Donors hereby gave full power unto the said Donees Kalinga Thamis Nona and Dinayadura Abaran Silva to hold and possess subject to the aforesaid regulations the said undivided portion of land and all the rights title interest and privileges of us the said Donors in and to the same, and after their lifetime their heirs executors administrators and assigns to hold and possess subject to the Government regulations the same uninterruptedly for ever or to deal with the same as please."
